channel.title: The DP Pod: The Do Positive Podcast
channel.description:
Dan and Patrick's daily antidote to doomscrolling: the most consequential developments in science and tech with sources and honest disagreement, a daily mindset principle for good mental health (Think Positive — the first show to take mental health as seriously as the science), and one concrete action with real numbers — The Lever. Plus the Do Positive Dispatch: what listeners actually did. Do something about it.
AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

item.title: Ep 1: Two friends built a fourteen-show daily network by themselves with an AI pipeline instead of a studio.
item.description: The DP Pod: The Do Positive Podcast Two friends built a fourteen-show daily network by themselves with an AI pipeline instead of a studio. The most common media business model profits when audiences feel powerless. This show starts from the opposite conviction: individuals are not powerless. The DP Pod exists so builders, creators, and contributors finish each episode smarter about real progress and more convinced their own effort counts. ...
